LegalPage.description: Example content for this Supacharger demo. Replace this page with terms and a privacy policy appropriate to your application before launch.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body:
This demo is provided for evaluation, without guarantees of availability or suitability. Features and test data may change or be removed.

Use the demo lawfully. Do not abuse the service, attempt unauthorised access, or upload sensitive or confidential information. Keep your account credentials secure.

You may stop using the demo at any time. Access may be suspended to protect the service and its users.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
The demo processes the account details you provide, authentication information and data needed to run the features you use. Session cookies keep you signed in and remember preferences.

Configured hosting and authentication providers process information to operate the demo. Test accounts and their data may be deleted during maintenance. Do not submit sensitive personal information.
